match: ^a lasting object rule reading what its ability chose$
needs: A `LastingObjectRule` holds plain functions in the card's table, so it can't read the player or value a resolving ability chose; it needs that value carried with the effect, as a lasting rule's `about`.

match: ^a lasting block rule reading what its ability chose$
needs: A `LastingBlockRule` holds a plain function, so it can't read the color or player a resolving ability chose; it needs that value carried with the effect.

match: ^a static ability that makes cards outside the battlefield lose all abilities$
needs: `loses_all_abilities` is asserted to affect permanents, so "cards in graveyards lose all abilities" needs the engine to read abilities of cards in other zones through layers. Yixlid Jailer prints it.

match: ^a cost at resolution filtered by who is asked to pay it$
needs: A cost built at resolution filters with plain functions, so it can't read the player found as it resolves; `Asker` needs the payer.
api: Asker::payer(), read by the cost's filter
